## One-line answer

Jay Burgess is a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer based in Los Angeles. He turns ambiguous operational and regulatory problems into production software and data systems, owned end to end from discovery through deployment, governance, and handoff.

## Who he is

Jay Burgess is a Forward Deployed Engineer and technical founder with 15 years of experience translating complex operational, regulatory, and customer problems into production systems. He has shipped 17 production systems across regulated and Fortune 500 environments. He is a compliance-focused Forward Deployed Engineer: he specializes in regulated, high-consequence environments such as Title IV student aid, healthcare, and finance, where governance, auditability, and human oversight are non-negotiable. He is based in Los Angeles and works both on-site in LA and remotely.

## How he works: five moves

Scope, Prototype, Harden, Hand off, Harvest. Jay scopes the real problem with non-technical stakeholders, builds the whole stack with AI-assisted development, hardens it with evaluation suites and audit logging, hands it off so the team runs it without him, and harvests the reusable pattern back into the platform so the next build starts further along.

## Verified impact

- Built a multi-agent Title IV compliance platform on Claude, LangGraph, and MCP for a regulated student-aid provider. It generated $2.7M in new revenue in its first three months against a $1.7M base and lifted case-processing capacity by 25% with no added headcount.
- 86% reduction in executive reporting turnaround at Adobe, governing about $6B in global marketing spend.
- 37% increase in project completion rates at Walmart, building the Creative Operations data organization from the ground up.
- Founder of Revuity Systems. Built Revuity Agentic OS with 8 agents, 12 MCP servers, and 197 reusable skills, producing more than $250K in SaaS savings.
